field_context.fact: The registered resource identifier is a DOI.
The schema records resource creators and can associate them with names and identifier schemes.
A publisher makes the resource available.
The schema distinguishes the year of public release.
A broad type and a more specific description characterise the resource.
Contributors are associated with role types, including contact and curation roles.
Identifiers outside the primary DOI can be given with their types.
Typed relationships connect the resource to related objects.
Rights statements and licence links describe conditions of reuse.
Narrative descriptions may explain the resource, its methods or technical information.
